title: Trad Bot — ME Inverse SHORT OOS-2
description: Prospective-only paper SHORT contour (Issue #276, ME_LONG_V2_INVERSE_SHORT_OOS2_V1). Source: MOMENTUM_EXHAUSTION_REVERSE_LONG_V2 LONG. Frozen protocol: entry TTL 120 minutes, max hold 7200 minutes, STOP_FIRST intrabar priority, SL -10%, partial ladder TP1 +5% -> 50% of original, TP2 +7% -> 75% of remaining (37.5% of original), TP3 +10% -> all remaining; OOS-2-LOCAL capacity 12. Protocol fingerprint: 1d1e7b4d87c6125183887c8f054a4edb1ff3f0711e70da1feeb9b7e249d7b7ec. Partial TP legs are legs of ONE trade, never separate closed trades.

panels.title: Activation / Freeze / Fingerprint
panels.description: Frozen identity of this contour: status must be RUNNING with both protocol_fingerprint and freeze_ts present before any capture or entry. Reviewed fingerprint: 1d1e7b4d87c6125183887c8f054a4edb1ff3f0711e70da1feeb9b7e249d7b7ec

panels.title: Open Positions (of 12)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='OPEN';

panels.description: OOS-2 LOCAL capacity: at most 12 concurrent OPEN SHORT positions (protocol constant, never the global Settings.max_open_positions). Orange at 10+, red when full (12): further eligible events are refused with CAPACITY_REJECTED / ENTRY_CAP.

panels.title: Realized / Unrealized Net PnL (USDT)

targets.rawSql:
-- Equity/PnL semantics (round 6): derived from the SAME open-cost accounting as contour_balance_components(): balance = initial + closed net_pnl - open(entry_fee + entry_slippage + funding_paid - realized_legs_net). Entry costs count ONCE per position over the FULL original quantity (booked at entry), settled funding only after durable settlement, partial TP legs are never separate trades (realized_legs_net only), a CLOSED row counts exactly once via net_pnl. Unrealized is market-reference (entry_market_price - mark) x remaining_size, exactly like the engine's mark_to_market. The FLAG rows below report UNRESOLVED funding (never booked into the PnL rows above).
SELECT 'Realized (closed positions + committed partial TP legs)' AS metric,
       round(coalesce((SELECT sum(net_pnl) FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='CLOSED'), 0)
            + coalesce((SELECT sum(realized_legs_net) FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='OPEN'), 0), 4) AS value_usdt
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Unrealized (open, market-reference last mark)',
       round(coalesce((SELECT sum((entry_market_price - coalesce(last_mark_price, entry_market_price)) * remaining_size)
                       FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='OPEN'), 0), 4)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Equity PnL (engine accounting: realized + full entry costs + settled funding + market-reference unrealized)',
       round(coalesce((SELECT sum(net_pnl) FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='CLOSED'), 0)
            + coalesce((SELECT sum(realized_legs_net - entry_fee - entry_slippage - funding_paid)
                        FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='OPEN'), 0)
            + coalesce((SELECT sum((entry_market_price - coalesce(last_mark_price, entry_market_price)) * remaining_size)
                        FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='OPEN'), 0), 4)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FLAG: unsettled funding periods (frozen 8h interval, excluded from the rows above)',
       round(coalesce((SELECT sum(GREATEST(floor(extract(epoch from (coalesce(closed_at, now()) - entered_at)) / 28800) - funding_periods, 0))
                       FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position), 0), 4)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FLAG: durable funding obligations not yet settled (count)',
       round(coalesce((SELECT count(*) FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_funding_obligation WHERE status='OPEN'), 0), 4)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FLAG: staged terminal closes awaiting durable replay (count)',
       round(coalesce((SELECT count(*) FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_close_outbox), 0), 4);

panels.description: Realized = terminal CLOSED net_pnl (full positions, entry costs + settled funding + partial legs counted exactly once) plus committed partial TP legs of still-OPEN positions. Unrealized = market-reference (entry_market_price − last_mark_price) × remaining_size over OPEN positions (SHORT sign), identical to the engine's mark_to_market. Equity PnL adds the OPEN positions' full entry fee + entry slippage + settled funding (booked once, on the FULL original quantity) — the same open-cost accounting as contour_balance_components(), so it equals engine equity − starting balance. FLAG rows surface UNRESOLVED funding (unsettled periods and durable obligations) that is deliberately NOT booked into the PnL rows above.

panels.title: Open SHORT Positions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol, entered_at, deadline_at,
       entry_price, remaining_size AS qty_left,
       stop_price, target_price AS tp1, tp2_price, tp3_price,
       tp1_executed, tp2_executed, tp3_executed,
       round((entry_market_price - coalesce(last_mark_price, entry_market_price)) * remaining_size, 4) AS unrealized_usdt,
       round(entry_fee + entry_slippage + funding_paid, 6) AS open_costs_usdt,
       round(realized_legs_net, 6) AS realized_legs_net,
       round(funding_paid, 6) AS funding_paid
FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='OPEN'
ORDER BY entered_at;

panels.description: Live SHORT positions. Entry facts (entered_at, deadline_at, prices, original size) are immutable; only remaining_size and the stage flags move as the ladder executes. unrealized_usdt is market-reference (entry_market_price − last_mark, engine semantics); open_costs_usdt = entry_fee + entry_slippage + funding_paid is what the equity accounting subtracts on the FULL original quantity.

panels.title: TP Progress

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol, status, entered_at, closed_at,
       position_size AS original_qty, remaining_size,
       round(100.0 * remaining_size / position_size, 2) AS remaining_pct,
       tp1_executed, tp2_executed, tp3_executed,
       CASE
         WHEN tp3_executed THEN 'TP3 done (closed)'
         WHEN tp2_executed THEN 'after TP2 (12.5% left)'
         WHEN tp1_executed THEN 'after TP1 (50% left)'
         ELSE 'not started (100%)'
       END AS ladder_stage,
       exit_reason
FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position
ORDER BY entered_at DESC LIMIT 60;

panels.description: Partial take-profit ladder progress (Issue #276): TP1 closes 50% of the ORIGINAL quantity, TP2 closes 75% of the remainder (37.5% of original), TP3 closes all remaining (12.5%). Each stage fires at most once.

panels.title: Partial TP Executions (legs, NOT separate trades)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.executed_at, l.symbol, l.exit_reason, l.leg_seq,
       l.quantity, l.remaining_after, l.fill_price,
       round(l.exit_fee, 6) AS exit_fee, round(l.net_pnl, 4) AS leg_net_pnl
FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_close_leg l
WHERE NOT l.is_terminal
ORDER BY l.executed_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.description: One row per PARTIAL TP leg (TP1/TP2). A partial leg keeps the position OPEN, keeps its capacity slot and is counted inside that position's final PnL — these rows are NEVER separate closed trades.

panels.title: Closed Positions (full trades)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol, entered_at, closed_at, exit_reason,
       position_size AS original_qty, entry_price, exit_price,
       round(net_pnl, 4) AS net_pnl
FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='CLOSED'
ORDER BY closed_at DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.description: One row per FINALIZED position (terminal exit: TP3 / STOP_LOSS / STOP_LOSS_GAP / TIMEOUT). A position that fired partial TPs before closing is still exactly ONE closed trade.

panels.title: Wins / Losses by symbol (closed positions)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol,
       count(*) AS closed_trades,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0) AS wins,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl <= 0) AS losses,
       round(sum(net_pnl), 4) AS net_pnl
FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='CLOSED'
GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY net_pnl;

panels.description: Wins/losses count FINALIZED POSITIONS only — a partial TP is a leg of the same trade, never an extra win.

panels.title: Equity Curve (realized PnL over time)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t AS time, sum(delta) OVER (ORDER BY t, kind) AS realized_pnl
FROM (
  SELECT closed_at AS t, 0 AS kind, net_pnl AS delta
    FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position WHERE status='CLOSED'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.executed_at, 1, l.gross_pnl - l.exit_fee - l.exit_slippage
    FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_close_leg l
    JOIN dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position p ON p.position_key = l.position_key
   WHERE NOT l.is_terminal AND p.status = 'OPEN'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.entered_at, 2, -(p.entry_fee + p.entry_slippage + p.funding_paid)
    FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_position p WHERE p.status = 'OPEN'
) q
ORDER BY t;

panels.description: Cumulative realized PnL from the contour's own balance ledger: finalized position net_pnl at close + committed partial TP legs of still-open positions − their entry costs/funding at entry. No amount is counted twice.

panels.title: Source Capture / Expired / Capacity Rejected / Errors

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_event WHERE status='CAPTURED';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_event WHERE status='EXPIRED';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_event WHERE status='CAPACITY_REJECTED';

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dds.scanner_error
WHERE error_type = 'ME_INVERSE_SHORT_OOS2_SOURCE_CAPTURE_ERROR';
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dds.me_long_v2_inverse_short_oos2_v1_event WHERE status='ENTERED';

panels.description: Source pipeline health (fail-open capture with counters): CAPTURED = eligible (age < 120 min TTL), ENTERED = source events that opened a position (event ledger), EXPIRED = terminal TTL refusal, CAPACITY_REJECTED = terminal TTL refusal while the 12-local capacity was binding (ENTRY_CAP), errors = ME_INVERSE_SHORT_OOS2_SOURCE_CAPTURE_ERROR rows in dds.scanner_error (scanner itself never affected).
